edges.reason: setFeeTo authorizes the caller with msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setMigrator authorizes the caller with msg.sender == feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter authorizes the caller with msg.sender == feeToSetter.
feeToSetter state variable is the privilege guard for setFeeTo.
feeToSetter state variable is the privilege guard for setMigrator.
feeToSetter state variable is the privilege guard for setFeeToSetter.
initialize requires msg.sender == factory before writing token addresses.
factory state variable is the authorization check inside initialize.
permit enforces deadline >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
_update derives blockTimestamp from block.timestamp for TWAP accounting.
User supplied deadline is compared against miner influenced block.timestamp.
swap invokes the untrusted ISoulSwapCallee callback before verifying input amounts.
The external callee can re-enter swap while reserves and balances are inconsistent.
msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument to the external callback.
The to parameter selects the contract that receives the callback.
amount0Out is passed to the callback while state is stale.
amount1Out is passed to the callback while state is stale.
Attacker controlled data calldata is forwarded into the callback.
unlocked flag and the lock modifier serialize mint execution.
unlocked flag and the lock modifier serialize burn execution.
unlocked flag and the lock modifier serialize swap execution.
unlocked flag and the lock modifier serialize skim execution.
unlocked flag and the lock modifier serialize sync execution.
swap performs optimistic external token transfers via _safeTransfer to an arbitrary to.
burn sends underlying tokens out through _safeTransfer before state settlement.
skim pushes surplus balances out via _safeTransfer to a caller chosen address.
_safeTransfer executes the low-level token.call and decodes the returned data.
_update performs overflow-desired unchecked arithmetic on the price accumulators.
_mintFee mints protocol fee liquidity through _mint.
mint issues LP shares to the recipient.
burn destroys the contract held LP shares.
approve delegates to the private _approve writer.
permit applies the approval after signature verification.
The recovered signer address gates the approval written by _approve.
transfer moves balances from msg.sender through _transfer.
transferFrom moves balances through _transfer after the allowance check.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_mint increases totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balanceOf entry.
_burn decreases totalSupply.
_burn decreases the source balanceOf entry.
_transfer updates both sides of the balanceOf mapping.
mint calls _mintFee before computing liquidity.
burn calls _mintFee before computing payout amounts.
_mintFee reads the factory address to query feeTo.
_mintFee reads and clears the cached kLast value.
_mintFee uses totalSupply to size the fee liquidity.
mint finalizes reserves through _update.
burn finalizes reserves through _update after transfers.
swap finalizes reserves through _update after the invariant check.
sync forces reserves to balances through _update.
mint reads current reserves via getReserves.
burn reads current reserves via getReserves.
swap reads current reserves via getReserves.
mint queries token0 balance via IERC20.
mint queries token1 balance via IERC20.
burn reads token0 balance and pays out token0.
burn reads token1 balance and pays out token1.
skim reads the token0 balance to compute the surplus.
skim reads the token1 balance to compute the surplus.
sync reads the live token0 balance.
sync reads the live token1 balance.
_update writes the packed reserve0 value.
_update writes the packed reserve1 value.
_update writes blockTimestampLast.
_update accumulates price0CumulativeLast.
_update accumulates price1CumulativeLast.
getReserves reads reserve0.
getReserves reads reserve1.
getReserves reads blockTimestampLast.
createPair performs the create2 deployment with a caller derived salt.
createPair initializes the freshly deployed pair contract.
createPair writes the getPair mapping in both directions.
createPair appends the new pair to allPairs.
createPair increments the totalPairs counter.
permit recovers the signer with ecrecover.
permit uses DOMAIN_SEPARATOR to build the digest.
permit consumes and increments the nonces mapping.
constructor computes and stores DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
The pair constructor assigns factory from the deploying msg.sender.
amount0Out drives the optimistic token0 transfer in swap.
amount1Out drives the optimistic token1 transfer in swap.
to is validated against the tokens and used as transfer recipient.
data length decides whether the flash-swap callback is triggered.
_token0 is written into the token0 state variable.
_token1 is written into the token1 state variable.
tokenA participates in sorting, existence checks and the create2 salt.
tokenB participates in sorting, existence checks and the create2 salt.
owner is embedded in the permit digest and compared to the recovered signer.
spender is embedded in the digest and receives the approval.
value is part of the signed payload and the resulting allowance.
deadline is included in the digest and gates signature validity.
_feeTo is stored into the feeTo state variable.
_feeToSetter is stored into the privileged feeToSetter variable.
to receives the minted liquidity in mint.
to receives the withdrawn underlying tokens in burn.
amount0In is derived from the post-callback token0 balance delta.
amount1In is derived from the post-callback token1 balance delta.
balance0Adjusted feeds the multiply-based invariant check in swap.
balance1Adjusted feeds the multiply-based invariant check in swap.
blockTimestamp is truncated and written as blockTimestampLast.
timeElapsed scales both TWAP accumulator updates.
liquidity is the returned and minted share amount.
amount0 is the computed token0 payout returned by burn.
amount1 is the computed token1 payout returned by burn.
pair holds the create2 result that is initialized and registered.
recoveredAddress is validated against owner and address(0) in permit.
feeTo local controls whether fee liquidity is minted in _mintFee.
liquidity is the burned LP amount taken from the contract balance.

normalization_plan.reason: amount0Out is a swap argument that directly determines swap execution and transfers.
amount1Out is a swap argument that directly determines swap execution and transfers.
to is the swap recipient validated and used inside swap.
data is only consumed to trigger the external soulswapCall callback.
_token0 is only used to write token0 during initialize.
_token1 is only used to write token1 during initialize.
tokenA is only used within createPair for salt, ordering and mapping updates.
tokenB is only used within createPair for salt, ordering and mapping updates.
owner is only consumed by the permit digest and signature comparison.
spender is only consumed by the permit digest and approval.
value is only consumed by the permit digest and approval.
deadline is only consumed by the permit expiry check.
_feeTo is only used to update feeTo in setFeeTo.
_feeToSetter is only used to update feeToSetter in setFeeToSetter.
to is only the mint recipient inside the mint function.
to is only the underlying token recipient inside the burn function.
amount0In is a purely local intermediate of the swap balance reconciliation.
amount1In is a purely local intermediate of the swap balance reconciliation.
balance0Adjusted is a purely local intermediate of the swap K invariant check.
balance1Adjusted is a purely local intermediate of the swap K invariant check.
blockTimestamp is a purely local intermediate of _update accumulator math.
timeElapsed is a purely local intermediate of _update accumulator math.
liquidity is a purely local intermediate computed and returned by mint.
amount0 is a purely local intermediate computed and returned by burn.
amount1 is a purely local intermediate computed and returned by burn.
pair is a purely local intermediate holding the create2 result in createPair.
recoveredAddress is a purely local intermediate of permit signature validation.
feeTo is a purely local cache read inside the _mintFee fee logic.
liquidity is a purely local intermediate of the burn accounting.
